## Reading and Cleaning Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
library(ggpmisc)
library(broom)
library(patchwork)
library(hms)
library(readxl)
```

## Flux Calculations

```{r}
# Reading in excel files with pertinent data for equation:
# F = S/A * PV/RT

# F=flux (to be calculated)
# S=slope(found in master_table)
# A= area of stem (needed)
# P= pressure (needed)
# V= volume of gas analyzer (needed)
# R= ideal gas constant (constant)
# T= temperature (needed)

# Bringing in A and and V for trees
tree_chambers_raw <- read_excel("data_raw/chamber volume data.xlsx", sheet="tree chamber volume hand measur") |>
  select(2, 23, 24)

# Bringing in A and V for soils
soil_chambers_raw <- read_excel("data_raw/chamber volume data.xlsx", sheet="soil chambers dimensions") |>
  select(1, 7, 8)

```

```{r}
# Cleaning tree_chambers_raw
tree_chambers_clean <- tree_chambers_raw |> 
  mutate(`volume(cm^3)` = case_when(
    `Tree ID` == 1617 & is.na(`volume(cm^3)`) ~ 1170.7,
    TRUE ~ `volume(cm^3)`
  )) |> # Manually setting the chamber volume for NA value 1617
  mutate(volume_m3 = `volume(cm^3)`/1e6) |> # Conversion to m^3
  rename(area_m2 = `area meters squared`) |> # Renaming area column
  rename(tree_id = `Tree ID`) |> # Renaming tree_id column
  slice(-25) |> # Getting rid of an extra NA row
  mutate(surface = "stem") |> 
  select(tree_id, area_m2, volume_m3, surface)
```

```{r}
# NA value fixing
replacement_rows <- tree_chambers_clean |> 
  filter(tree_id %in% c("1602a", "1614a", "1616a")) |> 
  mutate(tree_id = str_remove(tree_id, "[A-Za-z]+$"))

tree_chambers_clean <- tree_chambers_clean |> 
  filter(!(tree_id %in% c("1602", "1614", "1616") & (is.na(area_m2) | is.na(volume_m3)))) |> 
  bind_rows(replacement_rows)
```

```{r}
# Cleaning soil_chambers_raw
soil_chambers_clean <- soil_chambers_raw |> 
  mutate(volume_m3 = Volume/1e6) |> # Conversion cm3 to m3
  mutate(area_m2 = area/1e4) |> #Conversion cm2 to m2
  rename(tree_id = Chamber) |> 
  slice(-c(n()-1, n())) |> # removing last 2 rows of NAs
  mutate(surface = "soil") |> 
  mutate(tree_id = as.character(tree_id)) |> 
  select(tree_id, area_m2, volume_m3, surface)
```

```{r}
# Making ONE chamber clean to append to the clean data w/ measurements
chambers_clean <- bind_rows(
  soil_chambers_clean |> mutate(tree_id = as.character(tree_id)),
  tree_chambers_clean |> mutate(tree_id = as.character(tree_id)))
```

It will select columns (in excel, these are labeled A=1, B=2, etc) that are important for getting the "clean dataset", which refers to datasets with: month (January, February, etc), tree_id (tree identifier), surface (soil, tree, or other), time_min (time with minutes divided into the hour; 10:30 would be 10.5), methane (ppm emission), time_proper (for the graphs, a standardized time reading, ie 10:15 instead of 10.25), and month_val (January=1, February=2, etc)

## Cleaning into structure

month, year, tree_id, tree_num, surface, time_min, methane, ch4_flag, time_proper, month_val, soil, stem

```{r}
# The format for all months will be similar, so the May data will be an annotated description of what the code is doing.

# Clean trees_may
trees_may_clean<-trees_may |>               # Creating a new dataframe (trees_may_clean)
  rename(month=Month) |>                    # Renaming month column header
  mutate(month_val = 5) |>                  # Set the month_val; value changes between months
  rename(tree_id=`Tree ID`) |>              # Renaming tree_id column header
  mutate(tree_num = as.character(tree_id)) |>  # Same value for this month (no A,B,C,D,E)
  mutate(tree_id = as.character(tree_id)) |>  # Changing tree_id to a character string instead of numeric (some trees are labeled as 1602A and 1602B in different months)
  rename(surface= Type) |>                  # Renaming surface column header
                  # Renaming time column header
  rename(methane = `CH4 ppm...9`) |>        # Renaming methane column header
  rename(time_min = time...8) |>            # Renaming time_min column header
  mutate(year=2013) |>                      # Mutating in a year column
  mutate(ch4_flag = ifelse(CH4flag == "n", 1, 0)) |> # CH4 flag binary coding (0=no flag)
  mutate(
  time_proper = as_hms(hms(seconds = 0, minutes = min., hours = hour)),
  time_min = hour + min. / 60
) |> # Using hms to create time_proper column; basing it off of the already made time column
  left_join(weather_may |> select(tree_id, soil, stem), by = "tree_id") |> # Join temp. info
  select(month,year, tree_id, tree_num, surface, time_min, methane, ch4_flag, time_proper, month_val, soil, stem) # Select only the columns that will be in final clean data set

glimpse(trees_may_clean) # Provides a look at dataframe structure; should see 100+ rows, exactly 7 columns, and no NAs (unless the Excel has the values as NA).
```

```{r}
# Clean trees june
trees_june_clean<-trees_june |> 
  mutate(month= "June") |>        # Manually set June as the month since there was no column
  mutate(month_val = 6) |>              # Changed month_val to 6 (for June)
  rename(tree_id= `Tree...1`) |> 
  rename(surface= location) |> 
  mutate(tree_num = str_remove(tree_id, "[A-Za-z]+$")) |>  # strip trailing letters
  mutate(year=2013) |>
  mutate(ch4_flag = ifelse(...11 == "n", 1, 0)) |> # CH4 flag binary coding (0=no flag)
  rename(time_proper = `Time of day`) |> 
  rename(methane = `Ch4 ppm`) |> 
  mutate(time_min = as.numeric(format(time_proper, "%H")) + 
   as.numeric(format(time_proper, "%M")) / 60) |>     # Formula for creating the time_min variable where it doesn't already exist. NOTE: create time_proper first to use.
  mutate(time_proper = as_hms(time_proper)) |> 
  mutate(tree_key = str_sub(tree_id, 1, 4)) |>
  left_join(
    weather_june |> select(tree_id, soil, stem), 
    by = c("tree_num" = "tree_id")
  ) |>
  select(month,year, tree_id, tree_num, surface, time_min, methane, ch4_flag, time_proper, month_val, soil, stem)

glimpse(trees_june_clean)
```

```{r}
# Clean trees july
trees_july_clean<-trees_july |> 
  mutate(month="July") |> 
  mutate(month_val = 7) |> 
  mutate(year=2013) |>
  rename(tree_id=Tree...10) |> 
  mutate(tree_id = as.character(tree_id)) |> 
  rename(surface= Type...11) |> 
  mutate(tree_num = str_remove(tree_id, "[A-Za-z]+$")) |>  # strip trailing letters
  rename(time=Time...12) |> 
  mutate(ch4_flag = ifelse(...17 == "n", 1, 0)) |> # CH4 flag binary coding (0=no flag)
  mutate(methane = CH4...14*0.0012*2) |> # Multiply by 2??
  
  # The below mutate() function is important and a humongous step that could improve analysis of data. The time was put in both a format of 9:30 and 930, which made for a complicated case_when() function that identified when Excel read the value in in its own time format (see labels) versus just numbers. 
  
  # Standardizing the method of time entry would be very smart for future use
  
  # Another quick note, the date on the time_proper will be TODAY'S (the day you run this code) date; this shouldn't matter because we are only interested in grouping by Month (which is a variable we've already coded)
  
 mutate(time_proper = case_when( 
  as.numeric(time) < 1 ~ as.POSIXct(as.numeric(time) * 86400), # Own Excel format
  TRUE ~ as.POSIXct(sprintf("%04d", as.integer(as.numeric(time))), format = "%H%M"))) |>
  mutate(time_min = as.numeric(format(time_proper, "%H")) + # Just numbers
         as.numeric(format(time_proper, "%M")) / 60) |> 
  mutate(time_proper = round_hms(as_hms(time_proper), secs = 60)) |> 
  left_join(
    weather_july |> select(tree_id, soil, stem), 
    by = c("tree_num" = "tree_id")
  ) |>
  select(month,year, tree_id, tree_num, surface, time_min, methane, ch4_flag, time_proper, month_val, soil, stem)
glimpse(trees_july_clean)
```

## Appending the datasets

```{r}
# Important: This is a very short and deceptively simple line of code; you must ensure all of the dataframes you're adding have identical structure (same columns with the same types)
trees_clean <- bind_rows(trees_may_clean, trees_june_clean, trees_july_clean, trees_august_clean, trees_september_clean, trees_november_clean, trees_january_clean, trees_february_clean, trees_march_clean, trees_april_clean, trees_may14_clean, trees_june14_clean, trees_july14_clean, trees_august14_clean, trees_september14_clean, trees_october14_clean) |> 
  mutate(surface = str_replace_all(surface, "tree", "stem")) |> # Replace stem -> tree
  filter(!str_detect(tree_id, regex("amb"))) |> # remove amb from tree_id
  filter(!str_detect(surface, regex("pore"))) |>  #remove pore measurements
  mutate(tree_id = str_to_lower(tree_id)) # fix capitalization of tree_id
```

## Functions and testing

```{r}
# Function to create models

#a function call is displayed, but needs to include 3 parameters: month (numerical), tree_id (which tree you want to see the regression of), and type (soil, tree)

create_model <- function(month_num, year_num, tree_id_val, type_val) { # Takes aforementioned parameters
  reduced_data <- trees_clean |> #makes a dummy dataset
  filter(month_val == month_num) |> # narrows down to month
  filter(year == year_num) |> # narrows down to year
  filter(tree_id == tree_id_val) |> # narrows down to tree_id
  filter(surface == type_val) # narrows down type
  
  reduced_model <- lm(methane ~ time_min, data=reduced_data) # produce and save a model
  print(summary(reduced_model)) # output is summary(model)

}
```

```{r}
# Test of create_model()
create_model(7, 2013, "1602", "soil")
```

```{r}
build_graph <- function(month_num, year_num, tree_id_val, type_val) {
  reduced_data <- trees_clean |>
  filter(month_val == month_num) |> 
  filter(year == year_num) |> 
  filter(tree_id == tree_id_val) |> 
  filter(surface == type_val)
  
  # Getting names for graph
  title_var <- paste(reduced_data$month[1], year_num, tree_id_val, type_val) # making title "Month tree_id and type"
  reduced_model <- lm(methane ~ time_min, data=reduced_data)
  intercept <- coef(reduced_model)["(Intercept)"] # save intercept for equation
  slope <- coef(reduced_model)["time_min"] # save slope for equation
  r2 <- summary(reduced_model)$r.squared # save r2 for equation
  label <- paste0("y = ", round(slope, 4), "x + ", round(intercept, 4),
                "\nR² = ", round(r2, 3)) # build the label of the equation

  #creating the plot
  ggplot(reduced_data, aes(x=time_proper, y=methane))+
  geom_point()+ 
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=F) + # adding the line
  labs(title = title_var, # title_var defined earlier in function
       x="time of day", # manual input of x label
       y = expression(CH[4]~ppm)) + # subscript of CH4
  geom_label(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label, hjust = 0, vjust = 1) + # adding equation
  theme_bw()
}
```

```{r}
# Test of function build_graph()
build_graph(8, 2013, "1606", "soil")
```

```{r}
master_table <- trees_clean |>
  filter(tolower(str_trim(surface)) %in% c("soil", "stem")) |> # choose only soil/tree type
  filter(!is.na(methane), !is.na(time_min)) |> # get rid of NA values
  group_by(month, year, month_val, tree_id, surface) |> # grouping by relevant variables
  summarise(
    model = list(lm(methane ~ time_min)), # a list of the items from a linear model in data
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    slope = sapply(model, function(m) coef(m)["time_min"]), # define and give value to slope
    r2    = sapply(model, function(m) summary(m)$r.squared), # define and give val to r2
    p_val = sapply(model, function(m) glance(m)$p.value) # define and give val to p_val
  ) |>
  select(-model) |> # deselect model (list of values from linear regression)
  mutate( # rounding the important numbers
    slope     = round(slope, 4), 
    p_val     = round(p_val, 4),
    r2        = round(r2, 4),
    month_num = match(month, month.name)
  ) |>
  rename( # renaming the columns for presentability
    "surface" = surface,
    "slope (ppm/hr)"  = slope,
    "r^2"      = r2,
    "p-value" = p_val
  ) |>
  arrange(month_num, tree_id) |> 
  select(!month_num)
```

```{r}
master_table_testing <- trees_clean_testing |>
  filter(tolower(str_trim(surface)) %in% c("soil", "stem")) |>
  filter(!is.na(methane), !is.na(time_min)) |>
  mutate(temp = if_else(surface == "soil", soil, stem)) |>
  group_by(month, year, month_val, tree_id, surface, temp, area_m2, volume_m3) |>
  summarise(
    model       = list(lm(methane ~ time_min)),
    flag_good   = sum(ch4_flag == 0, na.rm = TRUE),   # count of good (0) flags
    flag_bad    = sum(ch4_flag == 1, na.rm = TRUE),   # count of bad (1) flags
    flag_absent = sum(is.na(ch4_flag)),               # count of missing flag info
    total_n     = n(),                                # total rows in this group
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    slope = sapply(model, function(m) coef(m)["time_min"]),
    r2    = sapply(model, function(m) summary(m)$r.squared),
    p_val = sapply(model, function(m) glance(m)$p.value)
  ) |>
  select(-model) |>
  mutate(
    slope     = round(slope, 4),
    p_val     = round(p_val, 4),
    r2        = round(r2, 4),
    month_num = match(month, month.name)
  ) |>
  rename(
    "slope (ppm/hr)" = slope,
    "r^2"            = r2,
    "p-value"        = p_val
  ) |> 
  mutate(flux = (`slope (ppm/hr)` * volume_m3) / (area_m2*0.0000821*temp)) |>
  arrange(month_num, tree_id) |> 
  select(!month_num)
```
